build_CoefficientMapping: build a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic degree and order coefficients for a given lmax and mmax
create_CoefficientMapping_coefficient_id: create a coefficient index mask for spherical harmonics with specific degree lmax and order mmax using CoefficientMapping
create_CoefficientMapping_complex_idx: create real and imaginary part indices for a given order m using CoefficientMapping complex_idx method
build_SO3_Grid: build an SO3_Grid module to transform irreps to and from grid representation with configurable lmax and mmax
create_SO3_Grid_to_grid: create a grid representation from an irreps embedding tensor using SO3_Grid to_grid method with specified lmax and mmax
